newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar adds to modest gains by close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar adds to modest gains by close.

text.p: White sugar futures edged slightly firmer by the close on Monday but activity remained light due to national holidays and a dearth of fresh fundamental news, traders said.
The two nearby contracts dominated the market, although December and March traded only 397 anmd 355 lots respectively.
At the 1730 GMT close the December contract had eged to $330.20, up $1.50 and the March closed up $1.20 at 330.00.
Traders said a public holiday in Japan and the Jewish holy day of Yom Kippur had contributed to the market torpor.
Traders and analysts said market sentiment in London was still bearish in light of the weakness seen last week.
"It's still consolidating and waiting for the next move lower," said one trader.
Activity in Paris was similarly lacklustre, with December up 50 cents at $329.50 and March down by the same amount at $329.00. Matif volume amounted to 866 lots.
